content:
Soviet documentary about the work of Ivan Filimonenko, a Russian scientist, who invented ways of producing energy through cold fusion in 1957, achieve reactionless thrust for propulsion system and discovered a way to slow the aging process of the human body.  #ufotwitter 

His work was taken away and deeply classified by military department. Beside cold fusion he invented Magnetoplane craft that artificially generates electromagnetic fields that counteracts on Earth own.  

Below are main takeaways pulled from article about his Magnetoplane how it works.  

“Craft interacts with disks charged by the Earth’s magnetic field, hence the Lorentz force arises, which means it moves the aircraft.” (I.S. Filimonenko)  

We can conclude that Filimonenko’s magneto consisted of two disks, and the thrust was generated by the interaction of charged particles with a magnetic field. The design involved the rotation of the disks in opposite directions and some type of shielding circuit to protect against the external magnetic field. Two disks were necessary to balance the interaction system.  

The article also provided the following data: the discs were made of an insulator interspersed with metallic particles, each interacting with the field; when moving perpendicular to the direction of the field, the interaction force is maximum and disappears when moving parallel. The screen of the cover was designed to control this interaction so that only the maximum interaction force was used. It seemed to “shield” half of each disc from the external magnetic field.  

According to Filimonenko’s calculations, the discs rotated at 1000 rpm. This was enough to produce a lifting force of “tens of tons.” Thus, traction control was achieved by accelerating or decelerating the rotation of the discs.  

If i remember correctly Salvatore Pais disc rotates at 30.000 rpm. I don't know what to say anymore it's all tiresome we achieved many great things but as soon as discovery is been made all of that becomes classified by both US and USSR military departments.  

From all my posts here, you can see for yourself how long ago we knew everything we needed for clean, radiation-free energy and had knowledge for deep space propulsion that works on updated physical principles.
